This is another coordinated push by the hidden elites to disarm regular people piece by piece, using the modification excuse as straight manipulation to expand their control, criminalize more ownership, and leave only the powerful armed while boxing the rest of us in. It's all about locking down the narrative and blocking any real pushback against their agenda—don't fall for it.
